meta.description: Records one LLM/image call in Langfuse as an OpenTelemetry generation span (OTLP/HTTP JSON → /api/public/otel/v1/traces, ingestion version 4). Langfuse v4 rejects the legacy trace-create/generation-create ingestion events. trace_key is any stable string (e.g. 'post:<uuid>'); its SHA-256 gives the 32-hex trace id, so every call for one post lands in one trace. Links the generation to the prompt name+version. Tracing never blocks: failures return traced=false. Do NOT pass image bytes/base64 as input/output — pass descriptions, sizes, hashes or storage keys.
meta.inputs: trace_key, trace_name, generation_name, model, prompt_name, prompt_version, input, output, usage_input, usage_output, start_time, end_time, level ('DEFAULT'|'WARNING'|'ERROR'), status_message, metadata (object)
